interactables.description: The shattered First Seal floats in the center of the chamber, its fragments slowly orbiting a core of pure fracture energy. Two ritual circles glow on opposite sides — one radiating restorative light to the west, the other pulsing with destructive chaos to the east.

actionData.question:
The First Seal hangs before you, shattered and suspended. Two ritual circles pulse on either side.

To the WEST, golden light flows — the path of restoration. The Seal can be reformed, its power contained once more.

To the EAST, red-black energy crackles — the path of destruction. The Seal can be shattered completely, its power released.

This choice is permanent. Choose wisely.

npcs.description: The Sealed One — the entity bound within the First Seal since before recorded history. In its destruction form, it fights aggressively, channeling the Seal's fracture energy into devastating chaotic attacks. Fast and lethal, but fragile.

phases.name: Chaos Incarnate
phases.transitionMessage: The Sealed One absorbs the Seal's destructive energy! Its form destabilizes into pure chaos as its attacks become devastating!

phases.name: Annihilation
phases.transitionMessage: The Sealed One's form shatters! Raw annihilation energy floods the sanctum as the entity transcends physical form!

NO multiple figures, NO multiple poses, NO character sheet. Isolated on solid white background.
